text:
Sam H: Heads up — scheduled rolling reboots in ap-southeast1 for PSU firmware v1.4.2 that fixes NVLink transient flaps. Window: Tue 2026-04-07 00:30–04:30 UTC. We'll do 6 cohorts, ~20m per-rack, staggered. Hosted pools + dedicated-pool-az3 are in scope. Expect short reconnects and a small p95 spike.
Maria L: How much reserved/Dedicated capacity will be impacted? any SLA exposure?
Sam H: Short answer: ~6 racks touched, ~6% of regional GPU capacity; due to warm backfill and cross-region routing we expect visible capacity >=94%. No planned SLA breach but monitoring + escalation on standby.
Devon K: Can we canary 2 racks first (cohort 0) and wait 30m metrics? I can run the canary and watch p95/queue-depth.
Sam H: Yes — start with racks rack-09 + rack-12. If p95 < baseline+40ms and no nvlink errors, continue.
Devon K: Canary commands I plan to run:
```
# drain + reboot workflow (ops helper)
kubectl drain node/node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
./ops/reboot-rack.sh rack-09 --serial
```
Devon K: after reboot I'll run `./monitor/warmcheck --region ap-southeast1 --minutes 10` and report.
Lee P: Add KV cache reseed after each cohort — reduce cold-token latencies. We should run lightweight kvseed for 20m per-cohort.
Sam H: Agreed. Plan: kvseed run for 25m post-reboot per-cohort. Command: `./kvseed --pool hosted-apse1 --duration 25m`
Anita S: Ops question: how do we tag cost/credits if Dedicated customers see degraded throughput?
Sam H: We'll tag the maintenance in billing (maintenance:psu-fw-apse1-20260407) and coordinate with Support for any credit reviews if customers report sustained impact >30m.
Maria L: What about traffic routing — any prod routes to shift to eu-west temporarily?
Sam H: Smart routing already will favor other regions for latency-tolerant jobs. We'll temporarily raise cross-region fallback limit to allow more burst -> +10% capacity from other regions. Ops will track egress costs.
Devon K: Monitoring hooks: I'll add temporary alert: `gpu.nvlink.errors > 3m` and `region.apse1.capacity < 92%` -> pager to oncall.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance/6550012345-psu-fw-apse1 (Tue 2026-04-07 00:30 UTC).
Lee P: Rollback plan: if NVLink errors persist after cohort 2, halt and rollback firmware, mark rack for extended investigation and open INC.
Sam H: Acknowledged. Oncall standing by 00:15–05:00 UTC and will post live updates in #incidents if anything deviates.
Anita S: tagging support + account mgmt for high-commit Dedicated tenants so they get a heads-up email.
Maria L: :thumbsup: good plan. Please ping when cohort 0 completes.
Sam H: Will do. I'll post cohort-by-cohort timestamps and a short status line after each. Thanks folks.
